card.text: The larger, inner moon of Mars, marked by the wide Stickney crater.

introduction.text: Phobos circles Mars three times a day. It is drawing closer and will one day crash into Mars or break into a ring.

normal.title: Controlled multi-mission mosaic
normal.summary: Images from several missions matched to one surface; shadows and edited seams remain.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below an 11.1 km sphere from the 2023 model, with about 148 m spacing.

albedo.title: SPC relative albedo model
albedo.summary: Brightness solved with the shape from mission images, on the released relative scale; not calibrated albedo.

slope.title: Modeled surface slopes
slope.summary: Slope against modeled gravity, including rotation and the pull of Mars at its mean distance.
